what_it_does: Rapidus is a Japanese government-backed semiconductor manufacturing facility that is building advanced chip factories to restore Japan's leading position in chip production. The company focuses on deploying cutting-edge manufacturing technologies—including EUV lithography (a high-precision method for etching tiny transistors onto silicon), advanced packaging techniques (how multiple chips are bonded together), and vertically-integrated supply chains. The presentation describes how Rapidus is scaling chip production to smaller process nodes (more transistors per chip), optimizing the manufacturing yield (percentage of working chips), and ramping up volume production to become globally competitive.
